title: Transparency proof verification terminates for every u64 size
evidence: Fuzz run 34189460354 timed out after 1201 s in transparency_proofs. Root cause: largest_power_of_two_below shifted a probe until it exceeded n; for n > 2^63 the probe wraps to 0 and the loop never ends. Replaced by 1 << (n-1).ilog2(); regression test sweeps u64::MAX, 2^63, 2^63+1; 24 transparency tests green
notes: A denial of service against every verifier from one crafted proof, in the component whose whole point is that the verifier does not trust the log. Loops in verifiers must be bounded by the bit width of the input, never by its value
